MATTER / Landscape, weather & animal signs

Scapulimancy & plastromancy.

Historical oracle readings of shoulder blades and turtle plastrons, often involving cracks and inscriptions.

LEXICON / LANGUAGE & MEANING

Names in context.

Scapulimancy
Escapulimancia

Divinatory interpretation of a shoulder blade, with a specified historical method.

Plastromancy
Plastromancia

Divinatory interpretation of the plastron, the underside of a turtle shell.

Oracle bone
Hueso oracular

A bone or shell object used in a documented oracle procedure, sometimes bearing inscriptions.

PROVENANCE & INTERPRETATION

A practice,
a setting.

Shang oracle bones provide documented examples of these practices and early writing. The materials and procedures vary by tradition; museum objects and archival images support study without reenacting the process.

FIELD NOTE / METHOD

Keep a record.

  1. Select a cataloged existing object and retain its accession number.
  2. Describe the material, visible cracks and inscriptions from the catalog.
  3. Compare a published reading with the image, marking uncertain or missing features.
POTPOURRI / PHOTO GUIDE

What to include.

  • Send a permitted museum or archive image with full credit and object number.
  • Include an overview and a detail of the relevant inscription or crack pattern.
